assignments.canonical_scope_notes: Includes: explicit win/winner/champion of event or award; sporting titles and honor awards such as Nobel Peace Prize; explicit championship/title designated by a sanctioning body or Olympic designation; historical victory. A named electoral competition is conceptually an event, but winning the White House or a legislature is office/control, not event-winning.
